## What's new in 0.29.4

Some games lost EAX in an update, but their store still offers the original build: Steam as a beta branch, GOG as an older version you can choose in Heroic's "Modify Installation" or GOG Galaxy. The script now shows you how to switch back.

- The game's profile now says "(restorable)" next to its EAX versions. Right after the Status, it lists the steps to switch back, with a section for each store, such as "Restore on Steam" and "Restore on GOG".
- When you pick one of these games, the script checks which build is installed. If it's still the updated one, the script shows the steps and asks "Check again?" until you're on the original build, then carries on. Before, it only warned you and asked whether to install anyway.
- If the store doesn't record which build you have, as with some GOG offline installers, the script still warns you and asks whether to install anyway.
- Long warnings now wrap to fit your terminal.
